startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to start crawling from. The crawler follows same-site links breadth-first up to Max pages / Max depth.

maxPages.title: Max pages per run
maxPages.description: Hard cap on pages audited per run. Controls total cost.

maxDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxDepth.description: 0 audits only the start URLs, 1 adds pages they link to, and so on.

includePatterns.title: Include URL patterns
includePatterns.description: If set, only URLs containing at least one of these substrings are crawled (start URLs are always fetched). Example: /blog/

excludePatterns.title: Exclude URL patterns
excludePatterns.description: URLs containing any of these substrings are skipped.

checkBrokenLinks.title: Check internal links for 404s
checkBrokenLinks.description: HEAD-check every discovered internal link once and report broken ones per page. Adds a little time, no extra charge.

useSitemap.title: Discover pages from sitemap.xml
useSitemap.description: Also seed the crawl with URLs from the site's sitemap.xml (subject to the same filters and caps).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Auditing your own or client sites needs no proxy.
